partnershipPlan: A member of a regional epilepsy charity's advisory group and one nurse specialist review the charting form's equity items and the plain-language summary.
socialListening: No social media listening for this review; public app-store reviews are not treated as evidence.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I filled in the diary for two months and nobody at clinic ever opened it.
items.implication: Chart clinician response to app data as a feature.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: After a bad night he cannot remember what happened; the reminder helps, the diary does not.
items.implication: Chart features separately; reminders and diaries may behave differently.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: If we coach everyone on the app, something else in clinic stops.
items.implication: Chart the support effort reported alongside sustained engagement.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: My mother shares a phone with my dad and has no data; an app is not for her.
items.implication: Chart who was offered and excluded.

summary: Four composite voices on clinician response, memory, nurse time and access.
